title: decentralized-fmmc-admm: Decentralized ADMM for fastest mixing Markov chain design and graph-constrained doubly stochastic projection
description: Python implementation and reproduction scripts for (i) a decentralized ADMM for the fastest mixing Markov chain (FMMC) problem with a matrix-free Chebyshev-filtered spectral update, and (ii) an exact global-consensus ADMM for the Euclidean projection onto graph-constrained symmetric doubly stochastic matrices, including the node-local scalar-bisection solver, the project-then-average baseline, and all numerical experiments reported in the accompanying papers.
